policy.signal_board: Ranks skill only: sample size, hit rate against break-even, exact binomial p, false-discovery controlled q, bootstrap floor and a relabelling placebo. No money.
policy.staking_board: Ranks money only: flat one unit per bet at the observed price. A staking result never promotes a strategy.
policy.reward: 1000 points to a strategy that passes every signal gate; 0 otherwise. No partial credit.

signal_rows.name: Passing yards: Kyler Murray
signal_rows.rule: For each quarterback game after the third, the model line is the shrunk mean of that quarterback's own earlier games. The side is the one the model prefers. The outcome is the official passing-yard total on nfl.com.

signal_rows.name: Two-leg game parlay: the model's side in the two games of a week with the biggest disagreement
signal_rows.rule: Within each week, take the games where the model's spread differs from the market's by at least 2.0 points and pair the first two. A parlay hits when both legs hit.
